<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Digital ID Card – National Pharmacy Week 2026</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=League+Spartan:wght@400;700&family=Montserrat:wght@600;700&family=Tinos:wght@700&family=Noto+Sans+Devanagari:wght@700&display=swap">
<style>
:root{--bg:#f4f5f2;--panel:#fff;--fg:#17201c;--muted:#5d6862;--line:#d6dbd5;--accent:#0b7a3e;--accent-fg:#fff;--err:#b3261e;--stage:#e6e9e3;
box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#0f1512;--panel:#18211d;--fg:#e8efea;--muted:#9aa89f;--line:#2b3830;--accent:#4fcf88;--accent-fg:#06200f;--err:#ff8f86;--stage:#0b100d;color-scheme:dark}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#0f1512;--panel:#18211d;--fg:#e8efea;--muted:#9aa89f;--line:#2b3830;--accent:#4fcf88;--accent-fg:#06200f;--err:#ff8f86;--stage:#0b100d;color-scheme:dark}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg);font:16px/1.5 "Montserrat",system-ui,sans-serif;padding:28px max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px)) 48px max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px))}
.wrap{max-width:1000px;margin:0 auto}
h1{font-family:"League Spartan",sans-serif;font-size:clamp(1.8rem,5vw,2.6rem);line-height:1.1;margin:0 0 6px}
.lede{color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 24px;font-size:.95rem}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,360px);gap:28px;align-items:start}
@media (max-width:820px){.grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.preview{position:static!important;order:-1}}
form{display:grid;gap:14px}
.row2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}
@media (max-width:520px){.row2{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.field{display:grid;gap:5px;min-width:0}
label,.lbl{font-weight:600;font-size:.88rem}
input[type=text],input[type=email],input[type=tel]{width:100%;font:inherit;color:var(--fg);background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:10px 12px;min-height:44px}
input:focus-visible,button:focus-visible,.drop:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}
input[aria-invalid="true"]{border-color:var(--err)}
.err{color:var(--err);font-size:.8rem;min-height:1.1em;margin:0}
.drop{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:14px;border:1.5px dashed var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:var(--panel);cursor:pointer;min-height:68px}
.drop:hover{border-color:var(--accent)}
.drop small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:.8rem}
.tools{display:grid;gap:8px;padding:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:var(--panel)}
.zr{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}.zr input{flex:1;accent-color:var(--accent)}
.hint{color:var(--muted);font-size:.82rem;margin:0}
button{font:inherit;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;border-radius:6px;min-height:44px;padding:0 18px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);color:var(--fg)}
button.primary{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-fg);border-color:var(--accent)}
button.sm{min-height:36px;padding:0 12px;font-size:.85rem}
.btns{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.preview{position:sticky;top:16px;display:grid;gap:10px}
.stage{background:var(--stage);border-radius:10px;padding:18px 12px;display:grid;place-items:center}
#card{width:100%;max-width:300px;height:auto;display:block;cursor:grab;touch-action:pan-y;filter:drop-shadow(0 10px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.25))}
.status{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--muted);min-height:1.3em;margin:0}
.res{display:none;gap:8px;padding:14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:var(--panel)}
.res.on{display:grid}.res img{width:100%;max-width:240px;margin:0 auto;border-radius:6px}
[hidden]{display:none!important}
</style></head><body>
<div class="wrap">
<h1>Digital ID Card</h1>
<p class="lede">World Pharmacy Day · National Pharmacy Week 2026. Fill in your details, add your photo, then download your ID card.</p>
<div class="grid">
<form id="f" novalidate autocomplete="off">
 <div class="field"><label for="name">Name *</label><input id="name" type="text" maxlength="40" autocomplete="name"><p class="err" id="e-name"></p></div>
 <div class="field"><label for="college">College name *</label><input id="college" type="text" maxlength="60"><p class="err" id="e-college"></p></div>
 <div class="field"><label for="part">Participating in *</label><input id="part" type="text" maxlength="40" list="pl"><datalist id="pl"><option value="Poster Presentation"><option value="Quiz"><option value="Slogan Writing"><option value="Rangoli"><option value="Model Making"><option value="Debate"></datalist><p class="err" id="e-part"></p></div>
 <div class="row2">
  <div class="field"><label for="course">Course *</label><input id="course" type="text" maxlength="24" list="cl"><datalist id="cl"><option value="B.Pharm"><option value="D.Pharm"><option value="M.Pharm"><option value="Pharm.D"></datalist><p class="err" id="e-course"></p></div>
  <div class="field"><label for="sem">Semester *</label><input id="sem" type="text" maxlength="16" list="sl"><datalist id="sl"><option value="1st"><option value="2nd"><option value="3rd"><option value="4th"><option value="5th"><option value="6th"><option value="7th"><option value="8th"></datalist><p class="err" id="e-sem"></p></div>
 </div>
 <div class="row2">
  <div class="field"><label for="mobile">Phone no *</label><input id="mobile" type="tel" maxlength="10" inputmode="numeric"><p class="err" id="e-mobile"></p></div>
  <div class="field"><label for="email">Email *</label><input id="email" type="email" maxlength="60" inputmode="email"><p class="err" id="e-email"></p></div>
 </div>
 <div class="field"><span class="lbl">Profile photo * <span style="font-weight:400;color:var(--muted)">(up to 10 MB)</span></span>
  <div class="drop" id="drop" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Upload profile photo"><span aria-hidden="true" style="font-size:1.6rem">📷</span><span><strong id="dt">Tap to upload a photo</strong><small id="ds">JPG, PNG or WebP. Drag on the card to reposition.</small></span></div>
  <input id="file" type="file" accept="image/*" hidden><p class="err" id="e-photo"></p>
  <div class="tools" id="tools" hidden><div class="zr"><label for="zoom" style="font-weight:500">Zoom</label><input id="zoom" type="range" min="100" max="300" value="100"><output id="zo">100%</output></div>
  <p class="hint">Drag the photo on the card to move it.</p><div class="btns"><button type="button" class="sm" id="reset">Reset</button><button type="button" class="sm" id="change">Change photo</button></div></div>
 </div>
 <div class="btns"><button type="submit" class="primary" id="gen">Create &amp; download ID card</button></div>
 <p class="status" id="status" role="status"></p>
</form>
<aside class="preview" aria-label="Live preview">
 <div class="stage"><canvas id="card" width="1080" height="1920" role="img" aria-label="Live preview of the ID card"></canvas></div>
 <section class="res" id="res" aria-live="polite"><strong>Your card is ready</strong><img id="out" alt="Generated ID card"><p class="hint">If the download didn’t start, press and hold the image (phone) or right-click it (desktop) and choose Save image.</p></section>
</aside>
</div></div>
<script>
(function(){
var W=1080,H=1920,PH={cx:522,cy:883,r:228};
var $=function(i){return document.getElementById(i)},cv=$("card"),c=cv.getContext("2d");
var st={img:null,zoom:1,ox:0,oy:0,tried:false,touched:{}};
var bg=new Image();bg.onload=draw;bg.src="data:image/jpeg;base64,";
var SERIF='"Tinos","Times New Roman",Times,serif',HEAD='"League Spartan","Montserrat",sans-serif',SANS='"Montserrat","Noto Sans Devanagari",sans-serif';
function val(i){return $(i).value.trim()}
function hash(s){var h=5381;for(var i=0;i<s.length;i++)h=((h<<5)+h+s.charCodeAt(i))>>>0;return h}
function fit(t,maxW,size,min,fam,wt){var s=size;for(;;){c.font=wt+" "+s+"px "+fam;if(c.measureText(t).width<=maxW||s<=min)break;s-=1}return s}
function wrap(t,maxW){var w=t.split(/\s+/),o=[],cur="";w.forEach(function(x){var n=cur?cur+" "+x:x;if(c.measureText(n).width>maxW&&cur){o.push(cur);cur=x}else cur=n});if(cur)o.push(cur);return o}
function geom(){var im=st.img,d=PH.r*2,s=Math.max(d/im.width,d/im.height)*st.zoom,mx=Math.max(0,(im.width*s-d)/2),my=Math.max(0,(im.height*s-d)/2);
st.ox=Math.min(mx,Math.max(-mx,st.ox));st.oy=Math.min(my,Math.max(-my,st.oy));return{w:im.width*s,h:im.height*s}}
function fm(m){return m.length===10?"+91 "+m.slice(0,5)+" "+m.slice(5):m}
function draw(){
 c.clearRect(0,0,W,H);c.fillStyle="#fff";c.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
 if(bg.complete&&bg.naturalWidth)c.drawImage(bg,0,0,W,H);
 c.textAlign="center";c.textBaseline="alphabetic";c.fillStyle="#000";
 c.font="700 43px "+SANS;c.fillText("Digital ID Card",540,346);
 c.font="400 38px "+HEAD;c.fillText("WORLD PHARMACY DAY",540,421);c.fillText("NATIONAL PHARMACY WEEK-2026",540,473);
 var th="THEME : स्वस्थ भारत : Combating Antimicrobial Resistance",sz=39,tl;
 for(;sz>=26;sz-=1){c.font="700 "+sz+"px "+SANS;tl=wrap(th,860);if(tl.length<=2)break}
 tl.forEach(function(l,k){c.fillText(l,540,536+k*(sz*1.38))});
 /* photo */
 c.fillStyle="#ffc70f";c.beginPath();c.arc(PH.cx,PH.cy,PH.r+12,0,7);c.fill();
 c.fillStyle="#fff";c.beginPath();c.arc(PH.cx,PH.cy,PH.r+4,0,7);c.fill();
 c.save();c.beginPath();c.arc(PH.cx,PH.cy,PH.r,0,7);c.clip();
 if(st.img){var g=geom();c.drawImage(st.img,PH.cx-g.w/2+st.ox,PH.cy-g.h/2+st.oy,g.w,g.h)}
 else{c.fillStyle="#e4ebe6";c.fillRect(PH.cx-PH.r,PH.cy-PH.r,PH.r*2,PH.r*2);c.fillStyle="#b6c4bb";c.beginPath();c.arc(PH.cx,PH.cy-50,70,0,7);c.fill();c.beginPath();c.ellipse(PH.cx,PH.cy+190,160,125,0,0,7);c.fill();
  c.fillStyle="#4d5c53";c.font="700 28px "+SANS;c.fillText("Upload your photo",PH.cx,PH.cy+150)}
 c.restore();
 /* details */
 var mob=val("mobile"),rows=[["Name",val("name")],["College Name",val("college")],["Participating in",val("part")],["Course",val("course")],["Semester",val("sem")],["Phone no",fm(mob)],["Email",val("email")]];
 rows.forEach(function(r,i){
  var by=1152.6+i*81.2+43;c.textAlign="left";c.fillStyle="#000";c.font="700 48px "+SERIF;c.fillText(r[0],180,by);
  var sx=180+c.measureText(r[0]).width+16;c.fillRect(sx,by+8,1012-sx,3);
  if(r[1]){fit(r[1],1012-sx-12,48,22,SERIF,"700");c.fillText(r[1],sx+6,by-2)}
 });
 var id="ID-"+String(hash(val("name")+mob+val("email"))%1000000).padStart(6,"0");
 c.textAlign="right";c.fillStyle="#fff";c.font="700 28px "+SANS;c.fillText(id,900,1862);
}
/* validation */
var R={name:function(v){return v.length<2?"Please enter your name.":""},
college:function(v){return v?"":"Please enter your college name."},part:function(v){return v?"":"Please enter what you are participating in."},
course:function(v){return v?"":"Please enter your course."},sem:function(v){return v?"":"Please enter your semester."},
mobile:function(v){return/^[6-9]\d{9}$/.test(v)?"":"Please enter a valid 10-digit phone number."},
email:function(v){return/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/.test(v)?"":"Please enter a valid email address."}};
function check(i,show){var m=R[i](val(i));if(show){$("e-"+i).textContent=m;$(i).setAttribute("aria-invalid",m?"true":"false")}return!m}
Object.keys(R).forEach(function(i){
 $(i).addEventListener("input",function(){if(i==="mobile")this.value=this.value.replace(/\D/g,"").slice(0,10);draw();if(st.touched[i]||st.tried)check(i,true)});
 $(i).addEventListener("blur",function(){st.touched[i]=true;check(i,true)});
});
/* photo */
var file=$("file");function pick(){file.click()}
$("drop").addEventListener("click",pick);
$("drop").addEventListener("keydown",function(e){if(e.key==="Enter"||e.key===" "){e.preventDefault();pick()}});
$("change").addEventListener("click",pick);
$("drop").addEventListener("dragover",function(e){e.preventDefault()});
$("drop").addEventListener("drop",function(e){e.preventDefault();if(e.dataTransfer.files[0])load(e.dataTransfer.files[0])});
file.addEventListener("change",function(){if(file.files[0])load(file.files[0])});
function load(f){var e=$("e-photo");
 if(!/^image\//.test(f.type)){e.textContent="Please choose an image file.";return}
 if(f.size>10*1024*1024){e.textContent="That photo is larger than 10 MB. Please choose a smaller one.";return}
 var r=new FileReader();r.onload=function(){var im=new Image();
  im.onload=function(){st.img=im;st.zoom=1;st.ox=0;st.oy=0;$("zoom").value=100;$("zo").textContent="100%";e.textContent="";$("tools").hidden=false;$("dt").textContent="Photo added";$("ds").textContent=f.name;draw()};
  im.onerror=function(){e.textContent="That image could not be read. Try a JPG or PNG."};im.src=r.result};r.readAsDataURL(f)}
$("zoom").addEventListener("input",function(){st.zoom=this.value/100;$("zo").textContent=this.value+"%";draw()});
$("reset").addEventListener("click",function(){st.zoom=1;st.ox=0;st.oy=0;$("zoom").value=100;$("zo").textContent="100%";draw()});
/* drag */
var drag=null;
function pt(e){var r=cv.getBoundingClientRect();return{x:(e.clientX-r.left)*W/r.width,y:(e.clientY-r.top)*H/r.height}}
function inP(p){var dx=p.x-PH.cx,dy=p.y-PH.cy;return dx*dx+dy*dy<=PH.r*PH.r}
cv.addEventListener("pointerdown",function(e){var p=pt(e);if(st.img&&inP(p)){drag={x:p.x,y:p.y,ox:st.ox,oy:st.oy};cv.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);e.preventDefault()}});
cv.addEventListener("pointermove",function(e){if(!drag)return;var p=pt(e);st.ox=drag.ox+(p.x-drag.x);st.oy=drag.oy+(p.y-drag.y);draw()});
function end(){drag=null}cv.addEventListener("pointerup",end);cv.addEventListener("pointercancel",end);
cv.addEventListener("wheel",function(e){if(!st.img||!inP(pt(e)))return;e.preventDefault();var z=Math.min(3,Math.max(1,st.zoom+(e.deltaY<0?.08:-.08)));st.zoom=z;$("zoom").value=Math.round(z*100);$("zo").textContent=Math.round(z*100)+"%";draw()},{passive:false});
/* generate + download */
$("f").addEventListener("submit",function(e){
 e.preventDefault();st.tried=true;var ok=true,s=$("status");
 Object.keys(R).forEach(function(i){if(!check(i,true))ok=false});
 if(!st.img){$("e-photo").textContent="Please upload your profile photo.";ok=false}
 if(!ok){s.textContent="Fix the highlighted fields and try again.";var b=document.querySelector('[aria-invalid="true"]');if(b)b.focus();return}
 draw();$("out").src=cv.toDataURL("image/png");$("res").classList.add("on");
 var nm=val("name").replace(/[^\w]+/g,"_").replace(/^_|_$/g,"")||"card";
 cv.toBlob(function(blob){
  var p=window.claude&&claude.use?claude.use("downloads"):Promise.resolve(null);
  p.then(function(d){
   if(!d){s.textContent="Done. Press and hold (or right-click) the card below to save it.";return}
   d.save({filename:"ID-Card-"+nm+".png",data:blob}).then(function(){s.textContent="Saved."},function(err){s.textContent=err&&err.code==="declined"?"Download cancelled. You can still save the image below.":"Done. Press and hold (or right-click) the card below to save it."});
  },function(){s.textContent="Done. Press and hold (or right-click) the card below to save it."});
 },"image/png");
 s.textContent="Your card is ready.";$("res").scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth",block:"nearest"});
});
draw();
if(document.fonts&&document.fonts.load){Promise.all([document.fonts.load('700 43px "Montserrat"'),document.fonts.load('400 38px "League Spartan"'),document.fonts.load('700 48px "Tinos"'),document.fonts.load('700 39px "Noto Sans Devanagari"',"स्वस्थ भारत")]).then(draw,draw)}
})();
</script></body></html>
